name: When should I consider replacing my current kitchen flooring with a non-slip option?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider replacing my current kitchen flooring with a non-slip option?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider replacing your current kitchen flooring with a non-slip option if you experience frequent slips or near-slips, especially when the floor is wet. Other indicators include significant wear and tear on your existing floor, such as cracks, loose tiles, or worn-out finishes that compromise safety. If you have elderly family members, young children, or pets, upgrading to a safer surface proactively can prevent accidents and improve overall home safety.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider non-slip flooring if you have frequent slips, significant wear on existing floors, or want to improve safety for family members.
